केनेषितोपनिषद्^1 n.^2 T. of an Upaniṣad
(beginning w. केनेषितम्).
[1] Correction submitted by Marcis Gasuns on 20151202. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/169. note: kenezitopanizada n. or kenezitopanizad f. Added 'n.'.
[2] Correction submitted by Marcis Gasuns on 20151202. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/169.

2 केनोपनिषद् n. T. of an Upaniṣad (beginning w.
केनेषितम्).
केन्द्र n. the centre of a circle.
